name: Dai Nippon Toryo Company, Limited
summary: Dai Nippon Toryo Company, Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells coatings and jet inks in Japan, Asia, the Americas, and internationally. It operates through Domestic Coatings, Overseas Coatings, Lighting, Fluorescent Color Materials, and Other segments.
